description: List named components in the running/emulated design, with type and properties (Component.GetComponents). On large designs use filter/type/names_only to trim the response. Note: QRC only sees components whose Designer "Script Access" is set to External or All (None is the default) — a component missing here, or one that silently ignores writes, most likely needs its Code Name + Script Access set in Designer.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring; only components whose name contains it are returned

names_only.description: Return only name + type per component (drop properties) to save context

name: qsys_list_components
title: List components
